findings.message: A different agent (Claude) checked the work in a separate headless process.

The attestation shows no valid RED. The attested command timed out at 600000 ms and was SIGKILLed with no exit code. It wrote nothing to stdout or stderr, and the expected-failure literal did not match. The literal also conflicts with the assertion in the bound proof for feature line 99 (the 'a committed edit to required assertion source' currency example). Because there is no observed failure, there is no evidence that the proof fails for the intended missing behavior. Approval is refused.

The attested execution timed out instead of failing. termination = {exit_code: null, signal: SIGKILL, timed_out: true}, and duration_ms = 600020 against timeout_ms = 600000. A timeout or signal is a disqualifying outcome, so RED cannot be accepted. Rerun the exact Cucumber argv with an attestation timeout above the worst-case runtime. That runtime is one full fixed-lane observation through the CLI: runObserverCli's spawnSync allows up to 900_000 ms, and the run also includes candidate materialization. Alternatively, cut the scenario's arrangement cost so it reliably finishes inside the timeout. Then resubmit with a fresh attestation.

The expected-failure literal was not matched (matched: false), and both stdout and stderr are empty (0 bytes, sha256 of empty input). There is no observed failure to compare against the intended missing behavior at the actor boundary. Provide an attestation whose full stdout or stderr contains the declared literal.

The declared expected-failure literal does not match what the bound proof asserts. Feature line 99 is the outline row 'a committed edit to required assertion source'. For that row, currencyCandidate edits and commits packages/cli/tests/integration/planning-scope-review.test.ts, and the Then step asserts /Changed input file:packages\/cli\/tests\/integration\/planning-scope-review\.test\.ts/. The literal instead expects 'Changed input file:.project/tickets/PPHQN5-observe-bounded-delivery-proof/ticket.md; observe the new committed candidate'. That file is not touched in this row's arrangement. If that message appeared, it would mean contamination of the candidate (for example from copying untracked or uncommitted working-tree ticket edits), not the intended missing currency behavior. Make the literal and the proof agree. It should name the controlled assertion source and the observe-new-candidate recovery, or else explain and fix why the ticket.md path would legitimately be reported.

The Given step 'a successful observation followed by (.+)' runs a full synchronous observation (spawnSync, up to 900 s) but declares no Cucumber step timeout. The 'When the maintainer verifies…' step and the regex Then steps also have no timeout, while other long steps in this file declare { timeout: 900_000 }. Depending on how Cucumber treats long synchronous steps, the scenario could fail with a step timeout or stall the event loop, which would be a wrong-reason failure. Give the long-running currency steps an explicit timeout, matching the other long steps.

createObserverCandidate copies the original working tree with 'git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard' and commits it. Uncommitted or untracked edits in the author's checkout, such as the PPHQN5 ticket.md named in the literal, therefore become part of the fixture candidate. That makes the arrangement depend on the reviewer's or author's local state. Consider documenting this or making the copied source deterministic, so currency rows can't report changed inputs they didn't arrange.
